title.narrative: Appraisal of the Danish Eastern Neighbourhood Programme, 2022-2026

description.narrative: The Russian invasion of Ukraine drastically altered the context for the next phase of the Danish eastern neighbourhood programme (DANEP) and by implication also the appraisal of the programme. The focus of this assignment was consequently reduced to conduct an early quality assessment of the overall programme design process, management and modalities, as well as three projects that can be implemented despite the invasion. A final desk appraisal is envisaged in second half of 2022, which will assess the uptake of the recommendations of this pre-appraisal and possibly also issue additional recommendations. As a consequence of the revised scope of the assignment, the tasks of the two consultants contracted for the appraisal were somewhat adjusted and a third consultant joined the team to provide additional targeted input to the assignment.

The objective of the appraisal was to assess the quality and feasibility of proposed projects under the Danish Eastern Neighbourhood Programme (DANEP) against the overall framework for Denmark’s partnership with the Eastern Neighbourhood Countries 2022-2026 and in line with the Aid Management Guidelines (AMG).
